methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on the accessed date. These are multi-carrier shipping platforms whose monthly subscription fee is the self-serve price; the carrier's actual postage/label rate is separate and usage-based, so minutesIncluded/callsIncluded/overage fields stay null as they do not apply to parcel shipping. Per-user/per-seat plans note seat counts; quote-only and contact-sales tiers (Enterprise, custom) are recorded with monthlyUsd null; every figure is sourced from the fetched page and none invented.

vendors.name: ShipStation
vendors.provenance: https://www.shipstation.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13). Plans restructured July 2025 from eight tiers to three with volume-based billing.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Base tier covers 50 shipments/month (scales 50-5,000 from $14.99 to $174.99/mo). 3 users, unlimited store connections, automated rate shopping, return labels, basic automations, reporting, email support. 30-day free trial, no card required.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Most popular. Base tier covers 50 shipments/month (scales 50-100,000+ from $29.99 to $3,599.99/mo). 10 users, unlimited automations, combine/auto-split orders, bring own carrier accounts, returns and exchanges, basic warehouse management, Shipping API, phone support.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Base tier covers 50 shipments/month (scales 50-100,000+ from $349.99 to $7,499.99/mo). 15 users, advanced inventory management (scan-to-receive, purchase orders, forecasting), advanced warehouse management, custom analytics, auto-routing, Cubiscan, ODBC access, dedicated implementation support.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Free. Up to 30 labels/month free; $0.08 per label beyond 10,000 labels/month, and $0.05/label when using your own carrier accounts. Discounted carrier rates, unlimited store connections, international shipping, automations, return labels, tracking, reporting, email support. 1 user login.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $17/month or $205/year (10% savings). Tiered options 1-10,000 labels/month. Everything in Starter plus AI-powered delivery estimates, free own-carrier connections, branded tracking pages and emails, chat and phone support. Up to 5 user logins.

plans.name: Premier
plans.notes: Quote-only (contact for pricing). Unlimited shipments. Everything in Pro plus dedicated account manager and 15+ user logins.

vendors.name: EasyPost
vendors.provenance: https://www.easypost.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13). API-first multi-carrier shipping platform.

plans.name: Free Access (Wallet Carriers)
plans.notes: Free for up to 3,000 labels/month using EasyPost wallet carriers. Includes labels, rate shopping, address verification, tracking, and insurance. Per-label fee applies beyond 3,000 labels.

plans.name: Bring Your Own Carrier Accounts (BYOCA)
plans.notes: $20/month plus a per-label fee. API access while using your own negotiated carrier accounts. Custom pricing available for higher volume.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only (contact sales). Custom pricing based on volume; includes EasyPost Forge (white-label APIs) and GlobalShip options. Tracking API priced separately at $0.01-$0.03/shipment; Insurance API at 1% of shipment value (min $1.00).

vendors.name: Pirate Ship
vendors.provenance: https://www.pirateship.com/ (official site; pricing confirmed across pirateship.com rate/UPS/USPS pages, accessed 2026-06-13).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Completely free: no monthly fees, no per-label fees, no markup on rates. Pirate Ship is paid by the carriers and passes through discounted USPS (up to 87% off Post Office) and UPS (up to 85% off Daily Rates) rates. Unlimited labels, no minimums or commitments.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: $14.99/month. 1 account user. Print up to 25 stamps and up to 10 shipping labels, schedule free pickups (UPS/USPS/FedEx), address verification and contact management, chatbot/help center support. 30-day free trial.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Most popular. $29.99/month. 3 account users. Unlimited stamps and shipping labels, Certified/Registered Mail, multi-address batch printing, tracking and notification emails, reports and analytics, international shipping, live chat and phone support.

plans.name: Multi-Location
plans.notes: $49.99/month. Up to 10 users per location, 2 office locations included (expandable). Everything in Professional plus user roles and location permissions, advanced multi-location reporting, dedicated enterprise account team.

vendors.name: ShippingEasy
vendors.provenance: https://shippingeasy.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13). Page renders higher-tier subscription prices via an interactive volume selector; only the Free and Growth starting prices were displayed on the fetched page, so tiers above Growth are recorded with monthlyUsd null.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Free. Up to 25 shipments/month. Discounted USPS and UPS rates, automatic order imports from up to 3 stores, ConnectEasy integration, shipping automation, cubic discounts.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Starting at $19.99/month for 26-200 shipments/month. Everything in Starter plus phone/email/chat support, unlimited stores/marketplaces, CSV uploads, branded tracking and custom label logos, robust reporting. 30-day free trial.

plans.name: Higher volume tiers (Basic / Plus / Select / Premium / Enterprise)
plans.notes: Volume-based subscription tiers above Growth (Basic 201-500, Plus 501-1,500, Select 1,501-3,000, Premium 3,001-6,000, Enterprise 6,001-10,000 shipments/month). Exact monthly prices are revealed only via the interactive volume selector and were not displayed on the fetched page, so recorded null.

vendors.name: Veeqo
vendors.provenance: https://www.veeqo.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13). Amazon-owned multichannel shipping software.

plans.name: Shipping (Free)
plans.notes: Free for everyone; Veeqo earns a small commission on labels purchased. Unlimited orders, users, products/SKUs, warehouses and shipments. Pre-negotiated carrier rates (Amazon Shipping, UPS, USPS, FedEx, DHL, OnTrac), up to 5% back in Veeqo Credits, multi-channel integrations, basic reporting. No per-label fees beyond carrier costs.

plans.name: Inventory
plans.notes: Starting at $19/month (usage-based, varies by monthly order volume). Adds automated inventory sync, demand forecasting, digital picking, unlimited listings on top of free shipping. FBA/MCF orders fulfilled by Amazon don't count toward chargeable volume.

plans.name: High Volume
plans.notes: Starting at $350/month (usage-based, varies by monthly order volume). Everything in lower tiers plus ERP integration (NetSuite), priority support, dedicated account manager.

vendors.name: Sendle
vendors.provenance: https://try.sendle.com/en-us/pricing (official US pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13). Carbon-neutral small-business courier; pay-per-package model, no subscription fee.

plans.name: Sendle Personal
plans.notes: No subscription fee, no contracts, no minimum orders. Pay-per-package only (rates vary by weight/zone/service: Sendle Saver, Preferred, 3-Day and 2-Day Guaranteed). Free pickup and dropoff, tracking and coverage included, savings up to 83%. monthlyUsd null because there is no flat platform fee.

plans.name: Sendle Premium
plans.notes: No subscription fee; tier unlocked at a minimum of 20 packages/month for better per-package rates. Pay-per-package only. monthlyUsd null because there is no flat platform fee.

plans.name: Sendle Pro
plans.notes: No subscription fee; tier for shippers sending 200+ packages/month, with up to 80% savings vs Personal, dedicated account management and priority support. Pay-per-package only; exact rate figures not published. monthlyUsd null because there is no flat platform fee.
